propositions: The lifespan drain waits only on queue.join() for webhook reviews, leaving reconciler.reconcile_once's inline review_and_vote call unprotected; when the queue empties the task is cancelled within 10s regardless of review duration.

Any container stop outside the autodeploy path (manual compose restart, host reboot, rollback) kills an in-flight reconciler review with no drain, and the silent failure leaves it unretried because reconcile is the retry path.

The fix implements cooperative shutdown: reconcile.request_stop() prevents new candidates from starting, the lifespan awaits both queue.join() and reconcile task completion under a shared shutdown_drain_seconds() budget gated on voter.in_flight_reviews().
Shutdown's break path must record remaining candidates in held_back to maintain the cursor low-water-mark invariant and prevent dropping patchsets outside the next pass's window.
The stop flag must clear at lifespan END, not START, so it does not outlive shutdown and silently suppress reviews in later reconcile_once calls within the same process.
Drain completion is proven behaviorally—a vote actually cast, not a stubbed count—and probes use asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking loops and executor starvation.
